topic: How does interleaved array element spacing affect coverage patterns and grating lobe suppression in Ka-band satellite links?
consensus_response: Interleaved element spacing directly impacts grating lobe suppression and interference levels in Ka-band satellite links.  Tighter spacing increases beam overlap, leading to strong grating lobes and interference, requiring advanced filtering techniques.  This trade-off between capacity and interference necessitates careful optimization of the interleaved spacing and phase-matching techniques to achieve optimal coverage and spectral efficiency.
